meta.title: About · Cosmic Studio, web studio in Geneva & Annecy
meta.description: Meet Cosmic Studio, a web and mobile studio between Geneva and Annecy, and Matthieu Compérat, your contact from the first call to ongoing care.

about.title: A small studio, working for your visibility.
about.lead: Cosmic Studio is Matthieu Compérat: a developer based in Chêne-Bougeries who builds websites and apps for craftspeople, associations and independents, from Geneva to Annecy.

path.title: Fifteen years of code, one point of contact.
paragraphs: Matthieu grew up in Duingt, on the shores of Lake Annecy, and has been building websites and apps for about fifteen years. First for large companies, where he learnt to build tools that are reliable, fast and accessible to all; then for people whose first names he knows.

Cosmic Studio grew out of that second choice: putting this know-how at the service of people who have a trade, and no time to learn a second one. You talk to the person who builds your site, from the first call to month-after-month care.

why.title: Craftspeople and associations deserve better than a template.
why.lead: Large agencies aim at large companies; site builders leave you alone with the tool. Cosmic Studio is for the people in between.

found.title: Get found close to home
found.description: Your customers look for you on their phones, a few kilometres away. A fast, well-built site makes the difference on Google.

price.title: A price that follows your business
price.description: A subscription from {price} a month that grows with you, rather than a large upfront investment.

answer.title: Someone who answers
answer.description: No help desk: the person who built your site answers you, usually the same day.

ai.title: AI when it helps, never in your place
ai.description: We use artificial intelligence to work faster, always with a human review. The details are in our legal notice.

cta.title: Let's work together.
cta.description: Tell us about your business in a few lines: we get back to you within 24 hours, with questions rather than an automated quote.
